content: OpenAI's documented API usage endpoints (developers.openai.com API reference, Administration > Usage) are GET api.openai.com/v1/organization/usage/{completions,embeddings,images,...} and GET /v1/organization/costs. They return token counts and dollar costs for API platform spend, require an API key with Admin roles, and have NO relation to ChatGPT Plus subscription message quota. ChatGPT Plus does not include API quota. There is no documented endpoint for Plus usage; the only way to read Plus/Codex quota is the undocumented chatgpt.com backend (wham/usage).
